content.value:
What we talked about

The devrelshow is Frédéric Harper's long-running conversation series with people working in Developer Relations. In episode 41 we talked about the job itself and how the way I build DevRel material was changing.

  • My story: from QA and development into Developer Relations, and what DevRel looks like at CKEditor.
  • DevRel in practice: what the work is about day to day, beyond the talks and the videos.
  • Vibe coding demos: the early stage of building demos and showcases with AI coding tools, as I was doing it at the time.
